title: Organizer data: latency spike on SW_CAMPUS_7
source_description: Records produced by the organizer's sample input generator (PS section 5), values unmodified; seeded, fixed clock, device chosen by rejection sampling.
limitations: Synthetic data from the organizer's sample generator (PS section 5), not real network data
The generator provides no topology; the star topology is an assumption by NetCoop
queue_drops, interface_errors and status are not used: their meaning is not defined by the generator
